---
title: I want to publish my data in a different repository. What are my options? 
categories: [Faculty Research Data, Deposit]
---

Depending on your discipline, funder requirements, dataset size, or sensitivity, another repository might be an even better fit than UC Berkeley Library Dataverse.

The UC Berkeley Library provides memberships to a variety of repositories, including [Dryad](https://datadryad.org/), [ICPSR](https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/sites/icpsr/home), and the [Qualitative Data Repository](https://qdr.syr.edu/). 

If you would like to discuss the data publication process and/or selecting the best repository for your work, please contact [librarydataservices@berkeley.edu](mailto:librarydataservices@berkeley.edu) or [schedule a consultation](https://berkeley.libcal.com/appointments/jakegibson).
